mode: READ-ONLY source audit; only assigned report and heartbeat written
purpose: Incident post-mortem and operator lifecycle cockpit: inspect source evidence, chronological updates, affected components and optional Helix summary.
primaryGoal: Understand a specific incident, append an investigation update or resolve it without losing the canonical timeline.

routeEvidence.detail: Mounted through SafeRoute; lazy import at line 296.

identity.scope: Assigned mounted detail page and its presentation/data dependencies, not all system pages.

dataSources.behavior: Positive IDs enable detail key ['status-incidents','detail',id]; null disables the noop key. Query function forwards AbortSignal. Raw snake_case incident timestamps, status, source, affected components and updates remain authoritative. Page reverses a copy of updates, leaving cache ordering unchanged.
dataSources.backendLimits: Repository ordering, transactional close-out rules, authorization and response nullability were not traced beyond route/handler evidence.

dataSources.behavior: Resolve sends {resolved:true}, invalidates ['status-incidents'], shows success/error toast; confirmation stays open on failure.

IncidentUpdateForm trims/validates message, permits optional lifecycle advancement, limits draft to 4000 characters, protects dirty navigation, retains draft on mutation failure and clears it on success.

integrationEvidence.detail: Handler supplied to AI route registration; exact nested AI route declaration not inspected.

dataSources.behavior: Opt-in withAiFeature gate; AI-off absent by contract, never substitutes canonical incident content. Positive integer incident ID, empty body, scopeKey bound to ID; hook source shows abort/reset on scope change.
dataSources.verification: Client URL and registration wiring inspected; nested route and live SSE behavior unverified.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Existing PageContainer props forwarded, full-width min-w-0 content; shell remains navigation/workspace owner.

components.name: SystemSummaryBrief
components.contract: OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics; title, description, scope, numeric StatMetric[] and text metrics, loading/available/retained/statusLabel/freshness.

components.name: GlassPanel/Button/Badge/ConfirmDialog/Typography
components.contract: Category barrel at page; localized actions, role typography, explicit confirmation and semantic badges. Only Button implementation inspected individually; other primitive internals unverified.

components.name: KVList
components.contract: Translated ReactNode labels/values; semantic dl/dt/dd; existing layout inline/stacked/responsive and wrap option.

components.name: IncidentTimelineList
components.contract: Newest-first updates, absolute localized dates, status, author, multiline message, empty recovery adjacent to form; uses canonical Timeline with summaryBounds.

components.name: IncidentUpdateForm
components.contract: Shared Textarea/Select/Button, required validation, pending state, dirty/navigation guards and independent mutation.

components.name: IncidentSeverityChip
components.contract: Localized severity with decorative icon; unknown severity label retained.

components.name: AIIncidentTimelineSummarizer
components.contract: withAiFeature and AIFeatureCard own opt-in presentation; caller supplies incidentId.

components.name: useDataState/StaleRefreshWarning
components.contract: fatalError only without retained data; stale/offline warning beside retained content, independent retry.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Existing useMotionPreference; reduced motion uses initial=false and zero delay; browser behavior unverified.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Status, source, duration and timestamps appear in summary, overview and detail list. These currently serve different reading contexts; duplication is not permission to drop fields.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep all contexts; derive consistent labels/display values once where useful, without introducing another stats component.

responsive.sourceStrategy: Both main bento regions stack at narrow widths and become three-column grids at xl; overview/timeline span two columns. Hero header wraps. Timeline messages use break-words and preserve whitespace.

issues.detail: Details call KVList with default inline layout and wrap=false. Long creator identities, translated labels and formatted dates have no responsive wrapping selected; the existing primitive only adds overflow-wrap/min-w-0 with wrapping or responsive layout.
issues.fix: Adopt existing KVList layout='responsive' (or stacked with wrap) preserving all eight rows, then verify 320px and long/RTL labels.

issues.detail: Affected component names are joined into plain body text; description at line 206 preserves whitespace but does not explicitly break long unbroken identifiers. Potential narrow-container overflow requires real-content verification.
issues.fix: Use existing wrapping utilities for long operator-authored values; preserve full text and selectable evidence.

sourcePositives: Shared semantic Timeline ordered list, accessible label and explicit oldest/newest summary bounds.
Form has accessible name, labeled required message and accessible status select.
Existing confirmation and reduced-motion primitives reused.
accessibility.verification: Keyboard order, focus restoration, screen reader, actual target spacing, contrast, forced colors and 200% text unverified.

issues.detail: Back and Resolve (line 197) request Button size='sm'; inspected Button owner defines h-9 (36px), below contract default 44px mobile target. No source evidence establishes the WCAG spacing exception here.
issues.fix: Use existing lg sizing or page min-height utilities for mobile; retain compact desktop when appropriate and verify non-overlap/spacing.

issues.detail: Initial-loading branch renders custom skeletons but does not pass loading/busy to PageLayout; PageContainer derives aria-busy and load announcements only from those props. The loaded branch also does not forward busy for refresh.
issues.fix: Forward existing busy prop for custom skeleton/refresh ownership without enabling replacement skeletons or suppressing retained content.

states.initialLoading: Summary loading plus two 240px skeletons and Back; timeline/form/AI absent until source resolves.
states.empty: Not-found page recovery, no-description placeholder, no affected components, timeline empty state, resolved update placeholder.
states.fatalError: useDataState.fatalError feeds QueryError with retry and list navigation.
states.retainedRefreshError: Incident remains readable; StaleRefreshWarning has retry; summary retained flag uses query.isError.
states.offline: Retained paused query warning supported by shared DataState; initial paused query handling and brief labeling have gaps.
states.mutations: Resolve and append have pending affordances, success/error toasts; failed append retains draft; resolved incidents intentionally read-only.

issues.detail: A valid initial query paused offline has no retained data, isPending=true but isLoading=false. It skips skeleton branch and reaches !incident not-found at line 120 despite no authoritative not-found response; initial isRefreshBlocked is available through DataState but ignored.
issues.fix: Distinguish invalid ID/authoritative absent response from pending-paused source; render shared unavailable/offline recovery without inventing an incident or asserting deletion/access denial.

issues.detail: Brief retained flag checks only incidentQuery.isError. A paused retained query is stale in DataState but brief says Source available, while adjacent warning says offline/retained.
issues.fix: Derive retained from incidentState.status/isRefreshBlocked; preserve recorded incident updated_at separately from last successful query observation.

visualIssues.detail: Severity chip uses fixed amber/orange/rose 300-level text and 500-level surfaces instead of theme-aware semantic tokens. No neon/glow is introduced here, but fixed pale text on light surfaces warrants verification.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic severity/status token contract, retaining all severity icons/labels and user theme preferences; measure composed contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Decorative timeline heading icon has fixed text-cyan-300 without a source semantic need.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted/secondary icon token rather than an independent palette; leave status accents semantic.

architectureIssues.detail: Vehicle-disabled exact set contains /system-status, not /system-status/incidents/:id; no /system-status disabled prefix. The actual detail URL therefore yields vehicle=true although useIncident is ID-only and consumes no vehicle selection. Range is correctly absent.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should make incident detail workspace semantics explicit using existing route-scope policy (disable vehicle for this system detail), not add a local vehicle/range picker or unsupported backend filter.

architectureIssues.detail: Finite positive route-number validation accepts fractional IDs; status handler parses base-10 int64 (incidents.go:244). AI child already uses Number.isInteger. Positive decimals produce avoidable rejected detail requests and unsafe integers can lose identity precision.
architectureIssues.fix: Use positive safe integer route validation with existing disabled-query behavior; test decimal, nonnumeric, zero, negative and unsafe values.

architectureIssues.detail: fmtDuration constructs English s/m/h/d suffixes and unlocalized digits. Absolute/relative dates already use central preference-aware useDateFormat; this duration bypasses that locale path.
architectureIssues.fix: Reuse existing locale-aware duration formatter at display boundary while preserving current rounding, elapsed interval and raw seconds. Do not introduce a conversion engine or change stored timestamps.

architectureIssues.detail: useToast imports a concrete feedback module from a feature despite category barrel already used for other feedback and by IncidentUpdateForm.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing @/components/feedback category export; shared implementation files keep concrete imports.

priority.rationale: Correct false not-found and inconsistent trust/workspace indication first; then narrow-width evidence readability, mobile targets and theme/locale consistency.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Incident detail workspace scope integration
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing getWorkspaceRouteScope(actual pathname): {range:false,vehicle:false} for incident detail; preserve all other route ownership and header/mobile selector behavior.
dependsOn: Existing WorkspaceRouteScope policy and application shell consumers
requiredSharedChanges.detail: No new shared component/API required; resolve exact-path versus descendant system-route ownership centrally.

competingImplementations.detail: Local severity palette parallels canonical semantic tokens; keep domain severity mapping but avoid establishing a second global status engine.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse/compose current tokens, not a new SeverityBadge library.

competingImplementations.detail: Current summary already adapts OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics; no evidence justifies replacing it with another KPI grid or adding a new timeline/layout/AI card.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse current owners and retain all specialist metric metadata.

Preserve all source status/severity/author/timestamps/components and newest-first display.
